title: SUN.io Completes 52nd Buyback and Burn: Total SUN Burned Surpasses 685M as SunSwap Accelerates Ecosystem Integrations
summary: SUN.io, the core DeFi liquidity infrastructure on the TRON network, has successfully executed its 52nd SUN token buyback and burn on October 27, removing more than 7.23 million SUN from circulation. This round marks the platform's 52nd consecutive burn, bringing the cumulative total to over 685 million SUN tokens, valued at more than $11 million.… Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next.
